title: Peace of Lund
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Peace of Lund", at revision 1352199504, opens: "The Peace of Lund, signed on 16 September (O.S.) / 26 September 1679, was the final peace treaty between Denmark–Norway and the Swedish Empire in the Scanian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q652359, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
